E.name: Evidence
E.meaning: Attach or inspect evidence without treating evidence as certainty.

F.name: Fold
F.meaning: Fold a state into recoverable memory while preserving lineage and residue.

G.name: Guard
G.meaning: Guard boundaries, authority, consent, and protected conditions before passage.

I.name: Invariant
I.meaning: Declare or preserve an invariant that must survive transformation.

O.name: Observe
O.meaning: Observe the stated target, context, or condition without silently changing it.

P.name: Prove
P.meaning: Prove only to the degree supported by visible evidence and unresolved unknowns.

U.name: Unknown
U.meaning: Mark unresolved information explicitly and preserve its type.

V.name: Vector Invert
V.meaning: Vector-invert a blocked or conflicting route into an alternative that preserves intent and constraints.

W.name: Weave
W.meaning: Weave participants or positions into coordination without merging their identities.

X.name: Exchange
X.meaning: Record a directional exchange of value, data, cost, consent, and reversibility.

Y.name: Yield
Y.meaning: Yield the resulting state, including scope, proof status, unknowns, dissent, and value flow.

Z.name: Compress
Z.meaning: Compress only when meaning remains recoverable; otherwise force semantic expansion.
